interface.longDescription: Tag Specsket Workflows Beta for guided product-ingestion and supplier-onboarding workflows. Enable the separate Specsket MCP Tools Beta connection once; ChatGPT can then use authenticated validation, staging, permanent review URLs, and one-time signed-in browser links automatically when needed. The plugin cannot publish or approve records.
